title: selfdoc check flags a bare kb/_self/ path in a skill or agent file the plugin ships
goal: python3 _tools/selfdoc.py check reports each kb/_self/ path in skills/*/SKILL.md or agents/*.md that is not under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/, since a project that installs the plugin cannot open a clone-relative path: SP-eptouzxc's ST-sle263pk added such pointers to skills/sprint/SKILL.md and agents/worker.md and every check passed (the review found it; the fix is parked as ST-2opghg5m)

run: import shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();c=d+'/c';subprocess.run(['git','clone','-q','--shared','.',c],check=True);f=c+'/agents/worker.md';open(f,'a',encoding='utf-8').write('\nSee kb/_self/planted-bare-path.md.\n');r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','check'],cwd=c,capture_output=True,text=True);o=r.stdout+r.stderr;print(r.returncode,o[-300:]);shutil.rmtree(d);sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 and 'planted-bare-path' in o else 1)
